profile.headline: FrontEnd Developer
profile.summary: Results-driven Frontend Developer with expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and frameworks like React, Next.js, dedicated to building cohesive, functional, and elegant user experiences using modern tools including Tailwind CSS. Proven ability to apply a logical, step-by-step approach to solve complex technical challenges, ensuring high performance and cross-browser compatibility. Eager to leverage problem-solving skills to drive user engagement and achieve business goals

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed a React-based frontend for Mon-Agent AI, automating client engagement for med-spas. Built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS; deployed via GoDaddy.

● Collaborated with the product owner to define specifications, layout, and site functionality

● Developed a custom food-service CMS for streamlined inventory, pricing, and image management. Built with a React/Node.js stack and MongoDB, featuring direct backend-to-frontend integration for real-time website updates

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
● Contributed to the Activation team, maintaining and enhancing the functionality and user interface of 1800flowers and affiliated brands like Harry and David, utilizing ReactJS, Javascript, NextJS, TypeScript, and Tailwind.

● Integrated and implemented the product review functionality of the website, including a customer rating system and a user interface for submission and display.

● Participated in the code review process, testing and reviewing other developers' code to ensure adherence to quality standards before transitioning to QA.

● Acted as a Release and Merge officer, confidently managing scheduled and unscheduled deployment tasks, which significantly increased the Activation team's deployment speed and frequency.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
● Served as the primary Front End Developer for the main e-commerce website, built with PHP, Laravel-Blade, Javascript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.

● Collaborated with cross-functional teams (product, development, customer) to provide accurate estimations and define new features for the site (pitboss-grills.com).

● Mentored and coached junior developers through pair programming, detailed code reviews, and active participation in design sessions and retrospectives.

● Developed and maintained the e-commerce website for Louisiana Grills, applying the same technologies and collaborative practices as the Pit Boss project.

● Contributed to all phases of the software development lifecycle, from estimation and feature definition to implementation and team development coaching.

● Led the creation of Dansons' web presence in the EU/UK markets by developing non-transactional sites for the UK, Germany, Australia, Denmark, Norway, France, Netherlands, Sweden, and Finland.

● Ensured all international websites accurately reflected product availability and local market requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed a purchasing order system for the trucking industry using ReactJS, NodeJS, Express, and MySQL (converted from Microsoft SQL), enabling real-time monitoring of truck statuses and driver information.

● Rebuilt the B2B website, migrating from WordPress to a modern stack (ReactJS, ContextAPI, NodeJS, Express, MySQL) and integrating PayPal API for e-commerce functionality and live admin updates.

positions.title: Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed an iOS application using React-Native that scanned QR codes to provide product information and link to PDF manuals.

● Managed client communication, gathered specifications, and ensured timely delivery, quickly learning new technologies (React-Native, Xcode) as required by the project scope.

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Plan, organize and implement projects and activities of team to support or achieve company and section goals/objectives
● Meets with clients/customers (FTL) to discuss system requirements, specification, project timelines and technical aspects of the project

● Prepares the Estimation of PF IO Inspection and Pattern Design Project using CATT software, CRAMAS peripherals, specification documents and man-hour needed.

● Checked and verify ECU software through source codes simulation in Centernet X Software

● Created check-sheet through excel application for the testing of CVT (Continuous Variable Transmission) and ENGINE software

● Performed thorough testing Design Review for all the projects to be submitted to the customer (FTL)

projects.title: Learning Vocabulary App
projects.description:
- Built using Node, Express, EJS templating, Knex, Postgresql and Google API translator
- An application for translating from foreign language to English. I helped in Database setup, routing setup, and made the design using css and bootstrap. This makes our app so cool and easy to use for studying different languages. This app was deployed in Heroku.

projects.title: Customer-Ticket-App
projects.description:
App created to facilitate the service for Agents and Clients by using chat rooms and text messages. This is a bare-bones version of our app, and this app has the potential be customized to serve a variety of purposes. This could be used as a customer ticketing app, in which users log in and able to speak with a live agent to troubleshoot their problem.

This could also be used as a lead capture portal for a lead generation campaign, in which sales prospects log on to the site to get more information about your product or service. They are then able to chat with a live sales rep to discuss you product or service in greater detail. All Customer/Client information is logged to a database, so email addresses can be then used for drip marketing campaigns down the road.
